audit_items.proof_trace: Property holds when RlpBehaviors parameter is consistent between encode and decode. All transaction types roundtrip correctly when the same RlpBehaviors flags are used. BlobTx has two valid forms (mempool vs execution) controlled by RlpBehaviors.InMempoolForm; cross-form conversion is intentionally asymmetric per EIP-4844 design (mempool→execution drops blobs, execution→mempool undefined). Tests verify same-form roundtrip for all types.
